name: Notion
description: Optional Notion website and official document API tools. Browser login and API access are configured separately.

website-url.title: Notion website
website-url.description: HTTPS Notion workspace or page URL. Reopen the Notion view after changing it. Browser login is independent of API access.

integration-token.title: Notion internal integration token
integration-token.description: Save in the host credential store. Connect the integration to the pages you want it to access in Notion. Never paste this token into chat or a normal setting.

interface.shortDescription: Notion website and bounded page tools through the official API.
